module: Entry point of rally mode (gameplay_rally extension). It owns the rally manager (RallyManager) loaded for a mission, relays updates to the recce app (RecceApp) and to the manager, provides the debug toolbox (ImGui), places a dummy co-driver in the driver's mirror seat, forwards input actions (recce, co-driver pacing) and handles the theme color of the UI streams. A rally modder uses it to load/unload a rally, read its state or adjust the co-driver pacing.
usage:
local ok, err = gameplay_rally.loadMission(missionId, missionDir, nil, nil, {owner = 'mission'})
if gameplay_rally.isReady() then local rm = gameplay_rally.getRallyManager() end
gameplay_rally.setUiColor('#ff0000')
notes: Manager owner (options.owner): 'mission', 'recce' or 'external' (default). A 'mission' owner is always allowed; 'recce' only in freeroam; the others are refused if a mission is in the foreground or if the manager belongs to a mission.
loadMission and unloadMission return false and a reason when the operation is refused or fails; getErrorMsgForUser keeps the message intended for the user.
The dummy co-driver is only placed if the owner is 'mission': the driver's mirror seat (L<->R) via gameplay_seatOccupants, replaced at the onSeatOccupantEnter/Exit hooks.
onUpdate does not update the manager while the recce recording is in progress (RecceApp.isRecording).
The stage runtime's authority mode defaults to 'shadow' when no manager is loaded.
The boolean mission settings (rallyRepairVehicleOnRecovery) are read from mission.lastUserSettings, then from the game settings, then the default value true.
The file contains many commented-out hooks (onRaceStarted, onRallyStageStart...): only those listed here are active.
The co-driver pacing is adjusted in steps of 0.1 s (CodriverTiming.nudge) and shows a UI message (category 'rally').

recceApp.desc: RecceApp module (rally recce app) exposed as is.

canManageMission.desc: Indicates whether the given owner is allowed to manage the rally manager.

loadMission.desc: Creates a RallyManager for the mission folder, sets the voicepack, rebuilds the assets and, on success, installs it and places the co-driver. Does not replace the old manager on failure.

voicepackPick.desc: Voicepack; nil = choice read from the mission's user settings (rallyVoicepackPick).

unloadMission.desc: Unloads the rally manager if the owner matches.

isReady.desc: Indicates whether a rally manager is loaded.

enableRecceApp.desc: Enables or disables the recce app (RecceApp.setEnabled).

getRecoveryRepairVehicle.desc: Indicates whether the vehicle must be repaired on recovery: asks the loop manager (gameplay_rallyLoop) if it exists, otherwise reads rallyRepairVehicleOnRecovery (mission setting, then game setting, default true).

setStageRuntimeAuthorityMode.desc: Passes the stage runtime authority mode to the manager.

mode.desc: Mode (default value 'shadow'; other values defined by the manager).

getStageRuntimeAuthorityMode.desc: Stage runtime authority mode of the manager, or 'shadow' without a manager.

getStageObserverState.desc: State of the manager's stage observer.

getDebugLogging.desc: Indicates whether the rally debug logs are active.

setDebugLogging.desc: Enables or disables the rally debug logs.

setUiColor.desc: Overrides the theme color of the Stage Timing / Progress streams. nil or an empty string clears the override.

getUiColor.desc: Current theme color: override if set, otherwise the loop manager's color (gameplay_rallyLoop), otherwise the standalone stream's, otherwise '#009a1a'.

toggleDebug.desc: Shows or hides the "Rally Toolbox" ImGui window (created on the first call).

getRallyToolbox.desc: Debug toolbox object (nil until toggleDebug has been called).

isRallyToolboxVisible.desc: Indicates whether the Rally Toolbox window is open.

getRace.desc: Race data recorded by the onRallyRegisterRace hook.

actionToggleMouseLikeVehicle.desc: Input action: toggles the mouse like a vehicle in the recce (if RecceApp is enabled).

actionTranscribeRecordingCut.desc: Input action: sends rallyInputActionCutRecording to the UI (cuts the transcription recording).

actionRecceMoveVehicleForward.desc: Input action: if the recce is active, sends rallyInputActionRecceMoveVehicleForward to the UI.

actionRecceMoveVehicleBackward.desc: Input action: if the recce is active, sends rallyInputActionRecceMoveVehicleBackward to the UI.

actionCodriverCallsEarlier.desc: Input action: advances the co-driver's calls by 0.1 s (shifts the delay range) and shows a message.

actionCodriverCallsLater.desc: Input action: delays the co-driver's calls by 0.1 s and shows a message.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: loads ExtHelper and sends rally.onExtensionLoaded to the UI.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: removes the dummy co-driver and unloads ExtHelper.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: updates RecceApp and the rally manager (except during the recce recording) and draws the Rally Toolbox if visible.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook: when player 0's vehicle is reset, notifies the rally manager.

onSeatOccupantEnter.desc: Seat hook: replaces the dummy co-driver (alias of the internal function seatCodriver).

onSeatOccupantExit.desc: Seat hook: replaces the dummy co-driver after an occupant leaves (the seat system removes dummy occupants on configuration respawns).

onSettingsChanged.desc: Settings change hook: notifies the rally manager.

onRacePathnodeReached.desc: Race hook: records a split time (recordSplit) for the pathnode reached; logs a warning if event.pathnode is missing.

onRallyRegisterRace.desc: Hook: stores the race data and passes it to the manager (setRaceData).

onRallyVehicleRecovery.desc: Hook: adds the recovery time to the manager (addRecoveryRaceTime).
